scenarios.check: Create small/empty/gzip objects; inspect creation status and final length
Upload raw 8 MiB as 6+2; inspect browser CORS and headers
Interrupt/discard PATCH response; HEAD; replay exact staged bytes
Inspect no-upsert collisions; resource expiry; canceled/late writes
JWT expiry and verified refresh without printing sessions
User B/anonymous read, write, HEAD, delete against A exact paths
Separately approved parallel resources/paths, capability replay and alternate upload methods
Trusted observed size, physical deletion and incomplete-resource cleanup

executionRules: No executor is enabled; running local tests must never trigger remote writes
Count every creation/alternate allocation attempt before sending, including failures and retries
Count all non-empty request bodies including Auth, control JSON and replayed PATCH data conservatively
Stop before sending any request that exceeds remaining allocation/body budgets
Select a staged subset across runs; the entire matrix may not fit one 12-allocation run
Do not add concurrency or lifetime/capability probes without explicit scenario approval
Stop on oversize acceptance or unexpected path allocation
Cleanup only exact ledger-owned bucket/path pairs, after outstanding attempts are reconciled
